title: Elodie and the Debt
premise: Cyrus Ravensworth, a deniable fixer for the Meridian Office—an embassy that exists on no map—has spent a career erasing other people's mistakes. When a dead informant's voiceprint unlocks a server in Tallinn, Cyrus discovers a scheduled 'accident' at a coastal refinery and an extraction flight leaving at dawn, and learns their own agency may have sanctioned it. Torn between loyalty to the handler who made them and the truth that could save hundreds, Cyrus races across three countries with Elodie Marchand, a forensic linguist whose voice matches the print. In the end, Cyrus chooses truth over duty: they expose the operation at cost of their own cover, stop the attack minutes before dawn, and board the flight as fugitives—together.
about_author: Odile Vane is the pen name of a former policy analyst who spent six years inside institutions she still cannot name, writing thrillers about the paperwork behind the violence. She lives near a harbor, keeps her drafts encrypted, and insists every plot twist in her books is technically plausible.

chapters.title: The Voice That Wasn't Hers
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. A routine cleanup in Rotterdam is interrupted when a dead informant's voiceprint unlocks a Meridian server in Tallinn—triggered by a stranger's voice. Emotional beat: professional calm cracking into unease as Cyrus realizes the system knew something they didn't.

chapters.title: Elodie Marchand, Linguist
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. A forensic linguist analyzing intercepted audio is visited by a man with no business cards who asks her to say four specific words aloud. Emotional beat: wary fascination; she agrees because the phrase matches audio from her murdered brother's last recording.

chapters.title: Deniable Assets
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Handler Marguerite Voss briefs Cyrus on a 'containment' job in Estonia but withholds the target. Cyrus notices the file lists Elodie as an expendable variable. Emotional beat: first flicker of disobedience disguised as diligence.

chapters.title: The Server Beneath the Ice
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. Cyrus and Elodie converge in Tallinn; the unlocked server reveals a scheduled refinery 'accident' timed to the dawn extraction flight. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance forged over shared grief and mutual suspicion.

chapters.title: Voss's Quiet Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Voss's POV (first time). She weighs collateral estimates against diplomatic exposure and authorizes the timeline anyway. Emotional beat: chilling bureaucratic serenity—the antagonist believes she is the loyal one.

chapters.title: Tail Lights on Pärnu Road
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. The pair flees a surveillance team through snowbound back roads after Elodie's hotel room is searched. Emotional beat: trust built under fire; Cyrus breaks protocol to protect her without being ordered to.

chapters.title: What Her Brother Knew
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Decoding her brother's recordings, she finds he'd discovered the refinery plot weeks ago—and was silenced for it. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into purpose; she stops being a passenger in the story.

chapters.title: The Embassy With No Address
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. A visit to the Meridian safehouse yields burned files and a colleague's warning: 'You were never meant to read past page one.' Emotional beat: loyalty to the institution begins curdling into betrayal's anticipation.

chapters.title: Riga Interlude
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. A stolen night in Riga—forged papers, cheap wine, almost-confessions. Emotional beat: love acknowledged obliquely, immediately shadowed by the knowledge that one of them may be bait.

chapters.title: The Extraction Manifest
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Cyrus clones the flight manifest and finds Voss's own name on it—she plans to be gone before the blast. Emotional beat: cold clarity; the mentor has already chosen her exit.

chapters.title: Counter-Voice
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Using voice synthesis and her brother's cadence models, Elodie crafts a spoofed command to delay the refinery's automated systems. Emotional beat: quiet triumph turning to dread when the spoof triggers a security alert.

chapters.title: Burn Notice, Reverse
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Meridian brands Cyrus compromised; old contacts go silent or hostile. Emotional beat: isolation—the fixer is now the thing to be fixed.

chapters.title: The Refinery at Night
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. Reconnaissance of the coastal facility: pipelines, a skeleton crew, a timer disguised as maintenance software. Emotional beat: awe and terror at how ordinary the machinery of catastrophe looks.

chapters.title: Voss Offers a Way Out
chapters.summary: Dual confrontation scene, mostly Voss's POV. She offers Cyrus reinstatement if they deliver Elodie and walk away. Emotional beat: temptation laid bare; Cyrus says yes to buy time, hating the taste of it.

chapters.title: Elodie Listens In
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Wearing a wire, she hears Cyrus accept the deal. Emotional beat: heartbreak weaponized—she decides to run the endgame alone rather than test his word.

chapters.title: Split Paths
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Discovering Elodie gone, Cyrus must choose: complete the betrayal and survive, or race her to the refinery control room. Emotional beat: the theme crystallized—loyalty vs. truth demands a decision, not a balance.

chapters.title: Ninety Minutes to Dawn
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. Parallel infiltration: Elodie reaches the control room, Cyrus draws the security detail, both bleeding time. Emotional beat: breathless momentum; every small victory costs something irreplaceable.

chapters.title: The Voiceprint Gambit
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Cornered by the system's final authentication, she speaks her brother's words in her own voice—and the machine accepts her, not him. Emotional beat: devastating tenderness; identity itself becomes the key.

chapters.title: Voss at the Airfield
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Confrontation on the tarmac as the extraction plane idles; Cyrus broadcasts the operation's evidence to three embassies mid-standoff. Emotional beat: the climax of principle—truth deployed as a weapon neither side can recall.

chapters.title: Accident Cancelled
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. The refinery sequence aborts with eleven minutes to spare; Voss boards alone and is detained by the very governments she played. Emotional beat: exhausted, disbelieving relief.

chapters.title: Passengers Without Papers
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Cyrus and Elodie board the dawn flight as unnamed passengers, careers burned, names unlisted. Emotional beat: bittersweet freedom—they saved everyone except themselves, and find that enough.

chapters.title: Epilogue: What the Server Kept
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV, months later. From a rented flat abroad, she receives an anonymous drive containing her brother's full file—and a single line from Cyrus: 'Some debts are worth keeping.' Emotional beat: open-hearted resolve; the sequel's door left ajar.
